notes.title: After months of hammer to code...
notes.notes:
Seduce Me the Complete Story has been updated to fix all Gallery bugs. How am I so confident this time?

I spent almost 5 hours speedrunning the game to unlock every single CG and checked every single one. They are all unlockable. They are all clickable. No errors occur in any span of accessing the gallery anymore.

Alongside other minor fixes and the like, this newest build is hopefully the FINAL build of Seduce Me: The Complete Story. Thank you for your patience thus far and please enjoy the build!

notes.title: Long Awaited: Steam Achievements Fix?
notes.notes:
So. It's been quite a while. As the only person who still has access to fix and work the game, when I was told of the issues with Steam Achievements, I was REALLY unsure of how this was happening. There were still records of them being unlocked by other players.

That said, after some digging, I found this to be a bug that was complicated with a simple answer.

I've uploaded a new update to Seduce Me: The Complete Story in the hopes of seeing this bug fixed. Should it still continue, the hammering shall as well. Please, if you had this issue, feel free to see if the achievements sync up and unlock for you! I would suggest starting a new game just to see if they sync, but it shouldn't require a full reset playthrough! Thanks! - Michaela

notes.title: Bad Ending CGs After Good Endings?! NO!
notes.notes:
So apparently people were getting the Bad End CGs instead of the Good Ending CGs unlocked in the Gallery.

That is absolutely wrong, so it's been fixed in this recent update!

Sale to come soon! Thank you so much for supporting Seduce Me!

notes.title: 1.4 - sm2?! NOT ANYMORE!
notes.notes:
Yeah.
So that was embarrassing.

"sm2" was somehow peppered all over the script! That's dumb!

So it's all clean now :D Enjoy!

notes.title: Gallery + Achievement Fixes
notes.notes:
Oops! Some things did not turn out okay in release (to no one's surprise. Game development is TOUGH!) so here's a patch to fix things!

I've looked into the gallery and why some pictures were not firing. Now, after beating the code with a hammer, things should be saving properly! If you don't want to go through the stories again, remember that the TAB button can fast-forward through sections you've already gone through!

As for achievements, I've done some internal updating to the code and hopefully they should fire! TAB is your best friend! If they still don't (which SHOULDN'T be the case), then I will be moving to the next plan to find out why.

Hope these fixes help you have a positive experience with Seduce Me! ~Michaela
